durable_state_limits.fact: the execution ledger and the nonce lane are per-process: production constructs a Ledger in exactly two places (crates/execution/src/sequence.rs, crates/execution/src/stage.rs) and no production code deserializes an ExecutionRecord
durable_state_limits.evidence: state_lifetime_recovery.rs:942 plus the mut-4 finding that §30's dedup is per-ledger
durable_state_limits.risk: a process that restarts between a send and its receipt cannot see the send it made; it is stopped only by what the chain reports (pending view ahead of the confirmed view) and, if the pool has emptied, it can re-derive the same bytes and re-send them
durable_state_limits.why_not_fixed_here: closing it needs a durable execution store, which is the second transaction-execution state machine §4 and §9 forbid
durable_state_limits.suggested_milestone: a persistence milestone, after M12-D's real-environment verification, where the receipt tracker is given a store it can be replayed from
